description: A painting of an underground station platform with tiled walls and steel girders. A short yellow electric car with lit windows stands at the platform, with a uniformed conductor in a peaked cap holding a lantern beside its doors. A crowd of people waits and boards: men in fedoras and overcoats and women in kimono, some carrying bags and an umbrella. The lighting is warm and smoky, and there is no visible text or frame; the painting runs edge to edge.
